question.text: PMs shall NOT invest clients' funds in portfolios managed by:

explanation.text: The Logic: Stacking one PM on top of another is prohibited. The Trap: Self-managed, MF, REIT investments are allowed subject to regulations. Cross-Exam Context: Same rule in III-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Fund-of-PMs structures are not a compliant route under current regs.
